_comment: Two rewrites, and the order matters — Vercel takes the first match.
/backend/* is a server-side proxy to the PHP API on Render. The browser
only ever talks to this vercel.app origin; Vercel's edge fetches Render
from its own datacenter. That exists because some ISPs blackhole TLS to
*.onrender.com (SNI filtering: port 80 connects, 443 times out, ping still
replies), which made the live site unusable on those networks even though
nothing was wrong with the backend. Proxying moves that fetch off the
visitor's network, and as a side effect the API becomes same-origin, so
The catch-all must stay last or it would swallow /backend/* and serve
